definition:
### Alpha and gradient
Panel on rgba(0,0,0,0.06) — a 6% black wash that is a light grey on a white page and nearly invisible on a dark one.
Gradient panel, #ffffff to #eeeeee, with #555555 text.

Body text at opacity 0.35 — inherits the theme colour but blends 65% into whatever is behind it.

Semi-transparent grey rgba(120,120,120,0.5) next to normal text.

Glass panel: rgba(255,255,255,0.08) fill, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) border.
intent: low-opacity, rgba and gradient overlays: alpha-blended fills and opacity:0.35 text over the message surface
